limits: Only independent_challenge is discharged, not Review Gate or failed/unavailable specialist stages.
No independent human/model family or normative reference implementation is claimed. Review author has inherited implementation exposure; external expected-value provenance is the independence.
RFC 6901 section 5 root slash example is kept with expected 0 even though saved model declares root aliases out of scope. A mismatch is a visible diagnostic, never relabeled RFC success.
This is a selected corpus, not full RFC 6901/6902 conformance or full Cartesian/falsifier coverage.
SpecStream JSONL is not an application/json-patch+json array or HTTP PATCH transport. Product no-op handling/continued streaming is not proof of RFC patch failure or HTTP atomicity.
No successful-test-operation proxy is counted as proof that test failures are enforced. RFC 6902 A.8/A.9/A.14/A.15 test-operation semantics are outside the changed claim.

URI fragments, malformed escapes, duplicate members, missing-parent creation, root replacement, out-of-bounds add, descendant moves, deep-copy aliasing and giant sparse-array writes are not certified.
No renderer parity, browser, React callback, resilience, hostile accessor/Proxy, cyclic/frozen object, deployment or security-stage completion claim.
Saved RFC texts are used locally with content hashes and excerpts, not network-retrieved or cryptographically authenticated in this resumption.
